gallery.hint: #screen=<id> opens a screen; only in DEV builds.

showcase.menuHint: Open by default; the ⋮ toggles, outside click and Escape close.
showcase.popoverHint: Open by default; the eye toggles, outside click and Escape close.
showcase.tooltipHint: Visible; the delay, triggers and viewport clamping are T-187's.
showcase.editorHint: Open on the seed's "Commit messages"; selection, tabs and the mode radio are local state.
showcase.editorEmpty: Instruction editor — the empty single variant
showcase.editorEmptyHint: "Pre-commit checks": LIB-014's dashed mark, LIB-036's disabled star, D-207's hint-less Delete.
showcase.editorCustom: Instruction editor — the per-project custom mode (MAIN-007, MAIN-034)
showcase.editorCustomHint: The .ie-custom window; switching replace/extend changes the placeholder and the base hint.
showcase.historyHint: The seed's demo revisions for "Commit messages"; the restore flow is a behavior card's.
showcase.restoreHint: Open on the seed history's deleted "Old wording".
showcase.variantDeleteHint: The count is derived from the seed assignments ("Spanish" — one project).
showcase.heading: Add/rename section dialog (LIB-030, 031)
showcase.headingHint: Open prefilled with a seed heading's name; validation is T-185's.
showcase.projectsScanHint: The demo walk's end state; both phases render at rest — the phase switch is the scan card's.
showcase.projectsSettingsHint: Open on seed project "{name}"; the active settings tab is the only local state.
showcase.projectsPreviewHint: The spec's build text — ALG-020 headings, no instruction names (ALG-022); not the demo's rendering.
showcase.projectsArchivedHint: The seed's demo list; Restore is inert — the restore flow is a behavior card's.
showcase.projectsExcludedHint: The seed's demo list; Remove is inert — the removal flow is a behavior card's.
showcase.syncSummaryHint: The demo run's end state; the outcome badge and the four counter chips derive from the rows.
showcase.syncPendingHint: The seed's dirty projects; Run sync is inert — the run is the sync card's.
showcase.settingsHint: The §6.5 seed values; the Backups field shows the demo's range-error state. Nothing applies — the settings card's.
showcase.activityHint: The seed's demo entries, newest first; the filters are inert — the combining query is the activity card's.
showcase.helpHint: Two full articles seeded, the rest two paragraphs; the article selection is local state, the search input is inert.
showcase.helpQueryHint: The query prop "sync": matching titles and body texts highlight, the counter shows; clear it to nothing for the empty state.
showcase.aboutHint: The product rows, the channel line and the collapsible licenses; the check button is inert — the update card's.
